title: Office Pantry & Beverage Program Terms Where Another Dining Service Line Is Held at the Same Site
content:
What a client holds elsewhere in the dining programme changes what the pantry charges and how it is delivered. The terms below state what an Office Pantry & Beverage Program programme carries where the same client holds another service line at the pantry's site.

## Where a cafe contract stands at the site

Where the same client holds an active Workplace Cafe Management Program contract at the pantry's site, pantry deliveries ride the cafe's own delivery run and the rush delivery charge is not raised on an unscheduled replenishment at that site. Where the cafe contract at the site closes or stands suspended, pantry deliveries move onto the district round and the rush delivery charge applies again from the next unscheduled replenishment.

## Where a micro market stands at the site

Where the same client holds an active Unattended Micro Market Program market at the pantry's site, the pantry's standing list is trimmed of the product groups the market already carries, and the product allowance printed against the pantry tier is unchanged, since the allowance prices the pantry rather than the site.

## Which tiers these two terms are written for

| Pantry tier | Rush delivery charge waived while an active cafe contract stands at the site | Standing list trimmed while an active micro market stands at the site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | yes | yes |
| Standard Snack Pantry | yes | yes |
| Fresh Pantry Program | yes | yes |
| Barista Bar Program | no | no |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | yes | yes |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | yes | yes |

## Barista bar and executive dining at one site

A barista bar programme and an executive dining cafe at the same site are mutually exclusive: the barista bar is served from the executive kitchen and is written into that contract rather than held as a separate pantry programme.

## Points of judgement

Question: a client holds an active cafe contract at the site and asks for an unscheduled replenishment of a Standard Snack Pantry there.
Answer: that tier is written for the waiver, so the rush delivery charge is not raised on the unscheduled replenishment at that site while the cafe contract stands active.

Question: the same client holds an active micro market at the site of a Barista Bar Program pantry.
Answer: the trimming of the standing list is not written for that tier.
